name: control
title: Control styles
description: Shared form-control and panel class recipes.

files.content:
export const controlBase =
  'h-[var(--lat-control-height)] w-full rounded-[var(--lat-radius-sm)] border border-line-strong bg-raised px-2.5 text-[var(--lat-text-sm)] text-ink transition-[border-color,background-color,box-shadow] duration-[var(--lat-duration-fast)] ease-[var(--lat-ease-standard)] hover:border-[var(--lat-text-faint)] focus-visible:border-action focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-action/25 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-45'

export const controlHeight = 'h-[var(--lat-control-height)]'

export const panelBase = 'rounded-[var(--lat-radius-lg)] border border-line bg-surface'
